title: AI-Powered Marketer
subtitle: Use AI across research, content, creative, automation and performance — responsibly and at scale
description:
Marketing teams that use AI well ship more, test more and learn faster, without losing their brand voice or breaking disclosure rules. This path takes you from AI fundamentals for marketers to a working AI marketing system. You learn to prompt for strategy, copy and sales assets, produce images, video and voice, and connect everything with email automation and no-code workflows in tools like n8n, Make and Zapier. Then you apply AI to paid media and to content at scale, with the quality controls that keep search engines and customers on your side.

The path closes with responsible AI: advertising disclosure, consent, copyright and platform policies, so your team can move fast with confidence. Every course is free and certificated; follow them in order or jump to the skills you need now.
outcomes: Build a repeatable AI workflow for research, briefs, copy and creative
Produce on-brand images, short video and voice-overs with current AI tools
Automate campaigns and lead handling with email flows and no-code AI automations
Use AI to plan, test and optimise paid campaigns against real conversion data
Scale content without thin or duplicate pages that hurt search visibility
Apply disclosure, consent and copyright rules to AI-assisted marketing
audience: Marketers, content leads and small agency teams
Creators and founders who run their own marketing
Anyone who wants AI to multiply output without lowering quality
